name: B10-0130/2025 (ESN) – Repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on repression by the Ortega-Murillo regime in Nicaragua, targeting human rights defenders, political opponents and religious communities in particular
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns Nicaragua's government, led by Daniel Ortega and Rosario Murillo, for persecuting Christians, political opponents and other religious groups. It also condemns the government for using migration as a weapon, letting migrants pass through and charging them high fees. The text supports the new United States administration's asylum and migration orders. It says sanctions on Nicaragua, especially by the United States and the European Union, are counterproductive and could push more people to leave. This is a statement of opinion; it does not change any law.

- The text states positions only; no law or policy changes as a result.
- It concerns Nicaragua's government, Christians, political opponents, migrants and the United States.
- It will be sent to European Union bodies, member states and Nicaragua's government.
